channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact prize - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Manuel António da Mota Prize – 17th Edition (2026)
    https://www.fmam.pt/edicao-em-curso-introducao/
    Fundação Manuel António da Mota (FMAM) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Total prize fund. The winning application receives a cash prize of EUR 50,000. Second and third place receive EUR 25,000 and EUR 10,000 respectively. The remaining 7 applications (honourable mentions) each receive a cash prize of EUR 5,000.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact prize - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Ars Electronica: State of the ART(ist) 2026 (Linz)
    https://ars.electronica.art/stateoftheartist/en/opencall/
    Ars Electronica, in cooperation with the Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs · deadline Closed 24 May 2026 · Main Prize EUR 6,000 plus Award of Distinction EUR 4,000. Both selected projects are presented at the Ars Electronica Festival (9 to 13 September 2026, Linz). No application fee.
